links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRES) of LLM and search engine outputs versus sixth-grade level
links.effect: MLLMs FKGL 11-14 versus search engines FKGL 6-7; no platform met the recommended sixth-grade reading level for consumer health information.
links.quote: No platform met the recommended sixth-grade reading level for consumer health information.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated health information for patients
links.effect: MLLMs produced complex, less-readable text (FKGL 11-14) compared with search engines (FKGL 6-7); none met sixth-grade level.
links.quote: MLLMs achieved higher DISCERN scores (2.84-3.20) but lower readability (FKGL = 11-14) than search engines (FKGL = 6-7).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic accuracy, information quality (DISCERN), and readability of several LLMs/MLLMs versus search engines on 100 oral mucosal case vignettes without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
